compliance.note: No proven fraud, regulatory investigation or fraud allegation identified for Straumann Holding AG in this search (no SEC/FINMA action found, no activist short-seller report). clesRetenues: Q China VBP - implementation timing: management has no official update, mentions a possible implementation in H2 2026, with a normalisation of patient flows and a restart of distributor orders.
Q Risk of an air pocket in Chinese demand if VBP is delayed: the CEO dismisses this risk, patients continuing to seek treatment as long as VBP appears less likely in the near term.

Q 2026 margin drivers: the CFO confirms the drivers remain unchanged - transformation of the orthodontics business and localisation of manufacturing in China as positives, FX volatility and customs tariffs monitored externally.
Q Growth in Latin America: the CEO attributes it essentially to volumes, driven by the roll-out of challenger implants across the region through the local subsidiaries.

dernierCall.guidanceProchainTrimestre: No quarterly guidance (Straumann guides on a full-year basis only). Next print: Q3 2026 organic growth (autumn), still to be presented by outgoing CEO Daniellot before the December handover to Christopher Norbye; China VBP 2.0 tendering could start in H2 2026 with operational implementation expected early 2027.
dernierCall.guidanceAnnuelle: FY26 outlook CONFIRMED at the H1 call (19/08/2026) after the 17/06/2026 ad-hoc raise: high single-digit organic revenue growth and core EBIT margin improvement of ~140-170bp at constant 2025 FX (vs +30/60bp initial February guidance). At July spot rates FX remains an expected 80-100bp headwind on the reported core EBIT margin. Management quantifies at least 2/3 of the margin upgrade as structural (opex discipline with flat headcount, manufacturing footprint incl. the fully operational Shanghai campus, procurement), the balance from milder US tariffs and the delayed VBP 2.0. CMD 2030 ambition reaffirmed unchanged (~10% organic CAGR, +40-50bp core EBIT margin per year on average, explicitly endorsed by the incoming CEO); ClearCorrect breakeven still targeted for end-2027.
pointsCles: CEO transition announced: Guillaume Daniellot steps down end-2026 after 7 years; external successor Christopher Norbye (ASSA ABLOY divisional CEO background, 8 years at Ossur early career) takes over in December and has explicitly endorsed the 2030 midterm guidance - main new watch item (execution continuity, management retention).

Broad-based acceleration: Q2 organic +8.5% (H1 +7.8%, revenue CHF 1,379.5M, +2.3% in CHF) with every region contributing - EMEA +8.6%, North America +8.4%, APAC +7.4% (ex-China +25%), LatAm +11.8% (H1 +15.4%); China improving sequentially ahead of VBP 2.0 (operational start expected early 2027, management sees max -5% to -15% ASP impact and a low comparison base since Q3 2025).

Margin delivery ahead of plan: core EBIT margin 25.7% reported / 26.9% at constant 2025 FX (+90bp comparable), driven by 130bp of opex efficiency with flat headcount on ~8% growth; core gross margin 70.5% (US tariffs -60bp, one-off Villeret equipment write-down -30bp); FCF +49% to CHF 169M (12.2% of revenue) as the heavy capex cycle ends.

Digital flywheel compounding: group estimates ~1/4 to 1/3 of global intraoral scanner unit sales over the last 12 months (SIRIOS X3-led), double-digit growth of the AXS connected-user base; iEXCEL now ~40% of premium implant volumes with no slowdown attributed to Nobel S-Line; ClearCorrect transformation on track for breakeven by end-2027.

hypothese.summary: World leader in dental implantology (Straumann premium + Neodent challenger), gaining market share continuously, with a structural margin expansion now accelerated by the raised 2026 guidance - Omnium projection deliberately more conservative than management's core consensus.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
World leader in dental implantology (premium Straumann + challenger Neodent, plus ClearCorrect aligners and the AXS digital ecosystem). Three structural pillars: an under-penetrated implant market (aging demographics, low treatment rates outside mature markets), share gains across price tiers, and digitalization pulling the ecosystem. The year's dominant signal: the June AD-HOC margin-guidance raise - core EBIT margin expansion lifted to +140/170bp cc from +30/60bp initial, with organic high-SD growth confirmed.

== THESIS READ ==
- A +100bp-plus ad-hoc margin raise mid-year is rare - cost leverage arriving faster than the CMD trend line. Watch: the H1 report (late August) decomposing the raise.
- Neodent's challenger economics keep widening the funnel in emerging markets. Watch: LatAm/APAC organic prints.
- ClearCorrect remains the fixable weak leg vs Invisalign. Watch: aligner volume trajectory.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Base = IFRS retreated ONLY of the true 2025 HQ-impairment one-off; PPA amortization AND recurring restructuring (present in all four regions + Operations in 2025) deliberately KEPT (anti-flattery policy) - hence the assumed gap vs core-basis consensus (3.00 vs 3.04-3.62), documented in the scorecard. FY25 below-EBIT block (-104: FX, leases, associates) documented as one-off-heavy vs the ~-14 normative. Shares constant.

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 2,748M (+5.5% reported, high-SD organic), EBIT 613M (Omnium base), EPS 3.00; 2027-2030: revenue +10%/yr, margin drift, ETR 20%, net cash building. Watch: H1 report (late Aug - imminent next anchor); CHF FX drag; China VBP implantology round effects.

== CATALYSTS ==
H1 2026 report (late Aug); Q3 organic print; ClearCorrect relaunch evidence; CMD trend confirmation.

ancrages.moteur: Group guidance raised on 17/06/2026: high-single-digit organic growth for 2026 confirmed, anchored on the sell-side consensus (CHF 2 748 M, +8,5% vs 2025).
CMD target of 25/11/2025: ~10% organic revenue growth CAGR over the 2026-2030 horizon, extrapolated at the same pace as the sell-side consensus beyond 2028.

Core EBIT margin raise of +140/170 bp announced on 17/06/2026 (vs +30/60 bp initially), translated on the Omnium adjusted IFRS basis (excluding PPA amortisation and recurring restructuring, reinstated by policy) into an expansion of about +90 bp in the 2026 adjusted EBIT margin.

CMD target of +40/50 bp of core EBIT margin per year over 2026-2030, translated into ~+55/60 bp of adjusted EBIT margin per year for 2027-2030, with a gradual normalisation expected of the 2025 restructuring charge (exceptionally high, present in the 4 sales regions + Operations).
Normative tax rate taken at 20%, consistent with the IFRS effective rate for 2025 (21,3%) and 2024 (17,9%), Pillar 2 adjustments already in force for the Swiss entities.

Net cash position (CHF -136 M in 2025, positive net cash), with no active and regular buyback programme identified -> net financial income computed at the Swiss 10-year rate + 2 pts of normative spread (~2,5%), marginal impact (<10 M CHF/yr) given the small amount.
Diluted share count historically stable (~159,1-159,6 M over 2021-2025), no massive buyback programme identified -> held constant over the projection horizon.

2025.residualNote: FY25 finNet (-104) bundles FX losses (CHF strength), lease interest and associate losses - far heavier than the ~-14 normative level projected; the gap is the below-EBIT one-off block of 2025, documented. Base retreated only of the true 2025 HQ-impairment one-off; PPA amortization and recurring restructuring KEPT (anti-flattery policy).
